headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians secured a thrilling 6-5 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Byron Buxton (Minnesota Twins), who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right hip impingement. Other injured players include Cole Sulser (Tampa Bay Rays), Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals), Casey Schmitt (San Francisco Giants), Beck Way (Kansas City Royals), Cole Sands (Minnesota Twins), Kerry Carpenter (Detroit Tigers), and Spencer Steer (Cincinnati Reds).

The Pittsburgh Pirates made a notable trade, acquiring Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles for cash. Additionally, the San Diego Padres signed Nu'u Contrades, and the Chicago White Sox acquired José Urquidy from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for Felix Doroteo.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Reds in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the Cincinnati Reds, with Kyle Manzardo leading the charge at the plate. Manzardo's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with a final score of 2-0. JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured an 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, overcoming a late deficit to claim the game. Brandon Lowe led the Diamondbacks' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 6-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, ultimately emerging victorious with a final score of 6-8. Impact hitters for the Marlins included Trea Turner, Justin Crawford, Otto Lopez, Heriberto Hernández, Esteury Ruiz, and Griffin Conine.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 3-0. Gabriel Moreno, Max Kepler, and Jared Triolo were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Byron Buxton Placed on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins center fielder Byron Buxton has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right hip impingement. The injury occurred on July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Pirates Acquire Rodríguez in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates have acquired right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash. This move adds depth to the Pirates' outfield.
